text:
Samira: hi everyone :wave: just got my company MBP (16-inch M2) and trying to enroll in MDM. Company Portal shows 'Enrollment pending' and FileVault didn't finish — I got an error 'FileVault enable failed (4922)'. Need to install Rosetta & Homebrew for my dev tools. Who should I ping for a short admin push?

IT Help: welcome Samira! :wave: Can you try signing out/in of Company Portal first? If that doesn't work, please paste the output of `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status` here. We'll re-trigger enrollment if needed.

Samira: ok pasted outputs: `profiles: There are no configuration profiles installed.` and `fdesetup status: FileVault is Off` — but System Settings is showing FileVault enabled and I got the 4922. macOS 13.6.1 (22G260)

jack-ops: hey Samira, I can re-trigger the enrollment and push a short-lived admin token. We don't give permanent admin rights — standard is a 60-minute sudo window. Want me to push now?

Samira: yes please, 60m is perfect. I need to install Rosetta, Homebrew, and Docker for Mac.

jack-ops: pushing enrollment + admin for 60m now. You should get a macOS notification and a Company Portal prompt to accept. After you accept, run:

```bash
softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
```

Also, to confirm MDM state you can run `profiles status -type enrollment` again and `fdesetup status`.

MDM Bot: Enrollment re-triggered by jack-ops for device serial ending in XXXXX123. Status: pending.

jack-ops: Looks successful on our side — admin push active for 60 minutes. Run `sudo -v` to verify you have sudo. If FileVault still shows conflicting states we'll escalate to imaging/Apple.

Samira: got the admin prompt :tada: Homebrew installed, ran Rosetta. Docker installer requested privileged access and installed. `fdesetup status` now returns: FileVault is On — weird earlier output must've been race. I'll reboot to be safe.

Diana: small heads-up: after FileVault flips you might see Spotlight re-indexing and higher disk activity. That's normal — let it finish. Also send a note to #devx if you need common brew taps preapproved. Here's the onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/devx/onboarding/basics

People Ops: Welcome Samira! :tada: Nice to have you. If you want a quick intro to the team, ping us for the 1:1 rota.

Samira: all set for now — thanks @jack-ops and team! :rocket:
